scope.reason: Tests 1-20 have mixed/manual methodology and provenance; tests 21-40 share the frozen V3 contract.

primary_predictive_metric.name: paired_log_loss_improvement_vs_entry_no_vig
primary_predictive_metric.definition: mean(logloss_market_entry - logloss_model) on the same settled V3 declarations

adjudication.DIRECTIONAL_PASS: All 20 V3 declarations settled with integrity PASS; paired log-loss improvement > 0; paired Brier improvement > 0; mean available CLV movement toward selection > 0; unit-stake P&L > 0.
adjudication.DIRECTIONAL_FAIL: All 20 V3 declarations settled with integrity PASS; paired log-loss improvement <= 0; paired Brier improvement <= 0; mean available CLV movement toward selection <= 0; unit-stake P&L <= 0.
adjudication.INCONCLUSIVE: Any mixed directional result, material close-price missingness, integrity failure, or incomplete settlement.
adjudication.interpretation: Directional pilot adjudication only. It is not a claim of statistical confirmation, calibrated superiority, or betting authorization.
